history.event: Claude refinement: 52 line(s) suggested — Corrected date headings (the cross was read as 𝓎/R/mi), names and common words (lalena, donna, farina, maddalena, fratello, chontanti, pezzi, scrissi, furono), and the sums (⫳ 17 not ⫳1𝒹, ⫳ 3, ⫳ 12.3.4, ƒ 8 di sug°, ƒ otto); there are no conventions files for this manuscript, so the existing Kraken glyph choices (⫳, ꝓ) were kept. | layout: l29: the box holds only the sum '⫳ 7' for the entry ending on l27 (maddalena); the ruled dashes run across l27's row; l44: the ⫳ at the right edge has no figure after it; the sum may be missing in the manuscript; l50: marginal sum 'ƒ 8 di sug°' belongs to the entry in l46–l49; l56: the box takes in only '4'; the ⫳/ƒ sign before it and 'La' after it fall outside the box (these are the sum for l51–l54); l33: date heading; Kraken read only noise; l53: the start of the line ('…nnn' before dallui) is not clear inside the box | doubts: l1: the sign after 'a' is probably the thousand sign of the year (MCCCCLXVI), not a lira sign; I kept Kraken's ⫳ and added the missing 'lx'; l3: surname read as 'dipierazzo' with low confidence; l4/l8: 'ebbi' or 'ebbe': the ending looks like i; l6/l36/l37/l46/l51: 'porro' is probably 'porto' (Kraken itself reads porto on l25); left as porro; l9: abbreviated word after 'donna' (q with a superscript) and 'andando' are unclear; l11: the day number is blotted (xx?); l20: first word (Dannino?) unclear; it may continue the 'd' at the end of l19; l33: the day figure and 'detto' are uncertain; l34/l35/l48/l53: several words are illegible to me and remain as Kraken read them or carry [?]; l42: the soldi figure after ß may not be 4
